import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Container, Typography, Grid, Card, CardContent, Button, Box, Paper, Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableContainer, TableHead, TableRow, Chip, Alert } from '@mui/material'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import axios from 'axios'; const AdminDashboard = () => { const [stats, setStats] = useState({}); const [pendingCompanies, setPendingCompanies] = useState([]); const navigate = useNavigate(); useEffect(() => { fetchAdminStats(); }, []); const fetchAdminStats = async () => { try { const [statsResponse, companiesResponse] = await Promise.all([ axios.get('http://localhost:5000/api/admin/stats'), axios.get('http://localhost:5000/api/admin/companies/pending') ]); setStats(statsResponse.data.stats); setPendingCompanies(companiesResponse.data.companies); } catch (error) { console.error('Error fetching admin stats:', error); } }; const approveCompany = async (companyId) => { try { await axios.put(`http://localhost:5000/api/admin/companies/${companyId}/status`, { status: 'approved' }); fetchAdminStats(); // Refresh data alert('Company approved successfully!'); } catch (error) { alert('Error approving company: ' + error.response?.data?.error); } }; return ( Admin Dashboard Welcome to the Admin Dashboard. Manage the entire platform from here. Students {stats.totalStudents || 0} Institutions {stats.totalInstitutions || 0} Companies {stats.totalCompanies || 0} Applications {stats.totalApplications || 0} Jobs {stats.totalJobs || 0} 👥 Manage Users View and manage all users in the system. 📊 System Reports Generate and view system analytics and reports. {pendingCompanies.length > 0 && ( Pending Company Approvals Company Name Email Industry Actions {pendingCompanies.map((company) => ( {company.name} {company.email} {company.industry} ))}
)} ); }; export default AdminDashboard;
